item.title: Ruben Gallego backs Graham Platner as Democrats split over Maine Senate race
item.description: The backing follows endorsements from Bernie Sanders and New Mexico Sen. Martin Heinrich.

item.title: Cal Maritime basketball teams lose in semifinals
item.description: It was a tough Sunday for the Cal Maritime men and women’s basketball programs as each team lost in the semifinals of the Cal-Pac tournament. The women’s team lost to Northern Mexico 80-77. Down to just five players, Cal Maritime needed a three to pull even against a team that had twice as many players […]

item.title: Local artist turns entrepreneur with Paint N’ Sip business venture
item.description: You might know her as the talent behind whimsical holiday window displays or the vibrant “Greetings from Vacaville” mural in progress across the glass façade of the Hyundai dealership. Either way, you’ve likely witnessed the work of local artist Valerie Billings-Swayne. Now the Solano County muralist is embarking on a new entrepreneurial venture, one that […]

item.title: Supreme Court preserves only GOP-held congressional district in New York City for 2026 elections
item.description: The outcome is a victory for Republicans in a national tug-of-war over redistricting.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks law against schools outing transgender students to their parents in California
item.description: Religious parents and educators challenged California policies aimed at preventing schools from outing children.

item.title: In a first as president, Trump says he’ll attend the White House correspondents’ dinner
item.description: Trump skipped the dinner throughout his first term and also missed last year’s event.

item.title: Democrats’ newfound unity faces a test after US and Israeli strikes on Iran
item.description: Some pro-Israel Democrats say they will not support a war powers vote to limit Trump.

item.title: Vacaville High girls soccer sweeps MEL awards
item.description: Junior striker Sophia Franzoni took home the league’s MVP award, while junior midfielder Samantha Mac Niven was named Offensive Player of the Year. Fittingly, senior twin sisters, Emma and Kallie Stacey were named Co-Defensive Players of the Year.

item.title: DA to seek consolidation Zizian suspect’s cases

item.title: Supervisors to discuss waste rate increase, government affairs
item.description: Facing a packed agenda Tuesday, the Solano County Board of Supervisors will discuss a possible waste rate increase for unincorporated areas of the county, hear a government relations update from state and federal lobbyists, consider a memorandum of understanding with the Solano County Deputy Sheriff’s Association, and hear a traffic analysis for Suisun Valley Road.
